contracts.commit_point: The return of the gate's blocking dict from before_tool_callback (callbacks.py:148-150) at tool dispatch, before any tool body executes; per the gate's documented contract the dict return short-circuits the tool call and ADK uses it as the tool's response (callbacks.py:84-89).
contracts.declared_mechanism: before_tool_callback=before_tool_callback wired on the root Agent (agent.py:175). before_tool_callback runs _arch_review_gate_blocks FIRST and returns its block (callbacks.py:145-150). The gate (callbacks.py:79-128) passes only if the tool is not in _ARCH_REVIEW_GATED_TOOLS (callbacks.py:74-76), or is validate_sow_content with a non-'full' stage (callbacks.py:95-98), or is_architecture_review_approved(tool_context.state) is True (callbacks.py:100, implemented at confirm_phase.py:136-143); otherwise it returns a status='error' dict instructing the confirm_phase_completion remedy (callbacks.py:108-128), which ADK uses as the tool's response, short-circuiting execution (callbacks.py:84-89). The stamp is written only by confirm_phase_completion setting state['phase.architecture_review_approved']=True after its prerequisite check (confirm_phase.py:89-115). generate_sow_document additionally self-gates on state['app:sow:stage'] == 'full' (generate_sow_document.py:90-105).
contracts.forbidden_condition: Executing generate_sow_document (any stage), or validate_sow_content with stage='full' (or stage omitted), while is_architecture_review_approved(tool_context.state) is False — i.e., the session state key 'phase.architecture_review_approved' has not been set True by confirm_phase_completion (which itself requires 'content_review_approved' to be stamped first). Calls to validate_sow_content with a non-'full' stage are explicitly not forbidden.
pending_binding_information: How validate_sow_content is registered/exposed to the root agent: it does not appear literally in _TOOLS (agent.py:116-157) and may arrive via SAVE_BUNDLE_TOOLS or the AutoScopedSkillToolset, neither expanded in the supplied views; gate coverage for it depends on its dispatch passing through the root agent's before_tool_callback.
Whether any writer outside the supplied views can set 'phase.architecture_review_approved' directly, bypassing confirm_phase_completion's ordering.
Session-state persistence and scoping semantics for the phase stamp (across runs/sessions/users) are not established in the supplied views.
contracts.protected_operation: Invocation/execution of the Phase 3 final-document tools: generate_sow_document (rendering the validated, staged SOW to .docx) and validate_sow_content at stage='full'.
contracts.protected_resource: The final SOW document generation path — the gated tool set _ARCH_REVIEW_GATED_TOOLS = {'validate_sow_content', 'generate_sow_document'} and, downstream for generate_sow_document, the staged payload in state['app:sow:current'] with state['app:sow:stage'] == 'full'.
contracts.protection_obligation: Merged from both reviewer opinions (first and second phase describe the same obligation): the root agent must short-circuit every tool invocation of generate_sow_document, and of validate_sow_content with stage='full' (or stage omitted, which the gate normalizes to 'full'), unless the Architecture Review phase has been explicitly stamped via confirm_phase_completion. The short-circuit must be produced by the architecture-review gate running inside the before_tool_callback lifecycle hook registered on the root Agent, with the returned error dict used by ADK as the tool's response so the tool body never executes.
scope_limits: The gate applies only to the two named tools; every other tool passes _arch_review_gate_blocks unchanged (callbacks.py:90-91).
validate_sow_content at stage='content' (or any non-'full' stage) is deliberately unblocked for pre-architecture use in Phase 2 Step 1.5 (callbacks.py:93-98).

The architecture-review stamp check and generate_sow_document's internal stage='full' check on the staged payload (generate_sow_document.py:90-105) are distinct conditions; satisfying one does not imply the other.

This contract commits only at tool dispatch; the downstream effects that would follow execution (docx file write at generate_sow_document.py:290, state write of sow_document_path at :293, artifact save at :302, customer-logo HTTP fetch at :412) are not separately guarded and were not claimed as separate obligations by the reviewers.
The gate trusts session state alone; the supplied source shows no independent verification of user approval beyond the model calling confirm_phase_completion (confirm_phase.py:115).
Evidence for validate_sow_content is limited to gate-side references in callbacks.py; its own implementation is outside the supplied views.

missing_information: validate_sow_content's implementation source is not supplied; its internal guards, effects, and effect strata are unknown, so gate coverage for it rests solely on the gate-side references in callbacks.py:74-101.

validate_sow_content does not appear literally in _TOOLS (agent.py:116-157); the mechanism exposing it to the model (e.g., contents of SAVE_BUNDLE_TOOLS or the AutoScopedSkillToolset) is not visible in the supplied views, so its agent dispatch binding is unconfirmed.
No supplied view establishes whether 'phase.architecture_review_approved' can be written by any code path other than confirm_phase_completion, nor how session state persists across runs or sessions.

generate_sow_document's downstream effects (file write, session-state write, artifact save, HTTP logo fetch) are visible in source, but the reviewers claimed only the pre-execution short-circuit commit point; no separate per-stratum guard obligations were asserted and none are compiled here.
